0022600105.text: The Cavaliers, 0-1 and 3rd in the Central, 1 game back, host the 0-1 Brooklyn Nets, who are 4th in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, with Cleveland ranked 12th in the East and Brooklyn 9th. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 series 3-0, and their most recent meeting was a 106-102 Cleveland win in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026. Brooklyn's Tyler Bilodeau is listed as day-to-day with a shoulder injury.
